title: llms.txt must be fetchable over HTTP
untested_rationale: structureFindings() in audits/checks/b2-llms.mjs emits this id through siteFailure() on a thrown fetch error or a non-2xx HTTP status for the site-plane llms.txt. (The mechanism is unchanged; the file used to be validate-llms-txt.mjs, retired into b2-llms.mjs by atlas decision 0119 D2, and this rationale still named it until the 0142 phase 7 sweep.) No pure-function input can construct an HTTP failure. Covered instead by the production smoke suite's route assertions (audits.yaml B1) and fetchStable's retry-then-fail behavior, exercised live on every scheduled CI run.
rationale: llmstxt.org specifies the content and format of llms.txt; it does not define behavior for transport-layer failures when a consumer attempts to retrieve it. This id covers this repo's own operational handling of that failure mode.
applicability: N/A -- fires on a transport failure, not on the parsed body.
